text_block_list.text:
On a day off, when I went to the movie theater—
Marvelous Sunday and Biko Pegasus were
sharing their impressions of a movie.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, that was so much fun!
It was a truly marvelous movie, wasn't it☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... but that alien was really evil!
Just because they needed kelp as UFO materials,
to suddenly try and invade Earth like that...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If aliens like that ever come to invade...
I'll definitely protect the Earth!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But, but, isn't there another choice besides fighting?
After all, we were lucky enough to meet across the vast universe!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But what if they're someone you can't reason with?
Even in the movie, they sneak-attacked the kelp merchants during negotiations—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: If that happens! We take the initiative and treat all the aliens to marvelous kelp dishes!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Even with aliens,
we can definitely achieve cross-cultural exchange☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Huh!? W-What's going on?
What happened!?

text_block_list.name: Fleeing Crowd
text_block_list.text:
R-Run for it!
I-It's a whole swarm of UFOs!

Before anyone realized it, UFOs filled the sky—
And from the craft landing by the cafe,
aliens holding ray guns emerged!
(Bzzzzzzzzt!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa!? They're shooting beams!
This is bad! I have to protect everyone!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wait! We finally crossed paths in this vast universe,
fighting each other isn't marvelous at all!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Even these alien folks have mouths
to weave marvelous words with☆
In that case, we should be able to communicate!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Now is the time to use
the alien language I learned from that magazine feature☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Marve-marve-velous, bay-marvelous☆
Velous-ma, marve-ve-la, velavelous★

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A-Are they communicating...!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: M... Marvelous-senpaaai!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Mm-hmm! It came right through the beam☆
Your feelings of anxiety—your fear of the unknown★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But you know what! That'll just lead to fighting!
Open your hearts wider! We
can definitely understand each other...☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now, take this! Infused with my feelings...
Marvelous Beam☆

text_block_list.name: Alien
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaahhhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Alien
text_block_list.text:
......Earth... beautiful...
Friends...... marvelous...☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: W-What, what!? What just happened!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I injected marvelous directly into their hearts
with my Marvelous Beam☆
Come on, Biko, you try it too★

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Eh!? U-Ummm...! L... Like this!?

text_block_list.name: Alien
text_block_list.text:
Gyo-gyo-gyo-gyo...! F-Friendship... bonds...
...Carrotman...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!? Did my spirit of justice reach them!?
S-So this is... the power of Marvelous...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now we're all friends!
Come on, altogether now☆ Marve-lous~★

text_block_list.name: Biko & Alien Army
text_block_list.text: Ma... Marvelous~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh... W-Wait?
Where are the UFOs? ...What in the world was that just now...?
choice_data_list: Did we... come back to our original world...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...See? As long as you open your heart to marvelous,
it'll definitely lead to a brand new marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And then the circle of marvelous will surely spread
across the entire universe☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see...! We should never forget the possibility
of becoming friends with anyone, huh!
choice_data_list: I-Is that... really how it works?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Marvelous Signal firing☆
Everyone in the universe, please receive it★
